lead: Movable things a household owns to keep people, property and the home safe — locks and padlocks, safes and key boxes, alarms and cameras, fire and leak detection, child-proofing and pest control — organised by threat (intrusion, fire, child injury, pests) and then by kind; built-in security (multipoint locks, installed intruder alarms, intercoms, window guards) lives in Home Fixtures.

depts.note: Tier for everyday door hardware; variety at the locksport / high-security end.

b.v: TS 007 3 stars > 1 star; BS 3621; Sold Secure Diamond > Gold > Silver > Bronze; ANSI/BHMA Grade 1 > 2 > 3; CEN 1-6; VdS classes
b.w: The independently tested grade comes first; padlocks and chains are bought the same way.
Comes after the grade.
Then fit.
Enthusiasts rank locks by how hard they are to pick.

s.brief: Tier shelf. Merge UK mortice kinds into one kind with types; merge night latch and rim lock; merge euro and rim cylinders into one 'Lock cylinder' kind with profile types (euro, oval, rim, key-in-knob, Scandinavian). Add the two missing modern kinds: Smart lock (August, Yale Linus/Assure, Nuki, Schlage Encode, Level, Ultraloq, Aqara) and Keypad door lock (mechanical push-button and electronic code locks). Cut models to market-covering brands (Yale, Union, ERA, Abus, Schlage, Kwikset, Eurospec) plus Which?/Consumer Reports test winners, ≈5–8 per kind. Multipoint locks and gearboxes have moved to Home Fixtures.

Add one new kind: portable Door security bar / travel lock (Addalock, Master Lock 265, door jammers) — a renter and traveller staple. Window guards and restrictors have moved to Home Fixtures; keep only window locks and lockable handles here. ≈5 models per kind.

Types: chain, swing-bar guard, hinged door guard.

s.brief: Pure restraint. Padlock duplicate already fixed: keep one kind, types open-shackle, closed-shackle, shutter, disc, combination, TSA/luggage, weatherproof. Cut padlock list to Abus, Squire, Master Lock, Yale, Ingersoll, plus Sold Secure Diamond test winners (≈8). Cut the 16-item hasp list to ≈6 across Abus, Squire, Master Lock, Yale. Chains and cables: types by Sold Secure grade and noose/loop; ground anchor keep ≈4.

Variety shelf for the lock-picking hobby. New kind High-security lock cylinder with archetypes ordered by significance: Abloy Protec2 (disc detainer), Mul-T-Lock MT5+ (telescoping pin + alpha spring), Medeco M3 (rotating pins + sidebar), EVVA MCS (magnetic), then ASSA Twin, BiLock, Kaba/dormakaba expert, Mul-T-Lock Interactive, Abloy Classic, Schlage Primus, Medeco Biaxial; each with versions (generations, Protec → Protec2, M3 → M4) and detail axes (profile, key control, keyway). Also new: Practice & cutaway lock (clear acrylic locks, progressive pinning kits, cutaway Abus/Master, challenge locks) and Lock pick set (hooks, rakes, tension tools, bypass and decoder tools as types; Sparrows, Peterson, Multipick, Southord, Covert Instruments). Use the LockPickers United belt list and Wikipedia/Wikidata as sources; makers go to the brand register.

s.brief: Tier shelf. Merge combined smoke-and-CO into Smoke alarm as a type (types: photoelectric, ionisation, dual, combined smoke+CO, smart). Brands FireAngel, Aico, Kidde, First Alert, Google Nest Protect, X-Sense, Hispec plus Which?/CR winners (≈6 per kind). CO alarm, heat alarm, gas detector, water-leak detector keep with ≈3–5 brands each; leak detector types stand-alone, smart (Govee, Aqara), with shut-off valve.

Per the findings, collapse eight extinguisher kinds into ONE 'Fire extinguisher' kind with agent as types: water, foam, dry powder, CO2, wet chemical, water mist, lithium-battery (AVD), aerosol spray can, automatic stove-top. Fire blanket keep. Add new sourced kind Fire escape ladder (hook-over window ladder, 2–3 storey). Household brands only (Kidde, First Alert, Firexo, Jactone, Britannia), no trade service kit.
